articles.summary: NFL free agency opened Monday with the legal negotiating window. We're following all the moves.

articles.title: Star WR Evans leaving Bucs to sign with 49ers
articles.summary: Star wide receiver Mike Evans is leaving the Buccaneers to sign a three-year deal with the 49ers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: Super Bowl MVP Walker to join Chiefs
articles.summary: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III has agreed to sign with the Kansas City Chiefs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Busy Titans add WR Robinson, DL Franklin-Myers
articles.summary: Wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson reached agreement Monday with the Tennessee Titans, reuniting him with offensive coordinator Brian Daboll, his former coach with the New York Giants.

articles.title: Cops responded to 911 calls before Pearce arrest
articles.summary: In the weeks before Falcons linebacker James Pearce Jr. allegedly rammed his vehicle into WNBA player Rickea Jackson's car, at least seven 911 calls indicate heightened fears from his unidentified girlfriend that she was being stalked and harassed.

articles.title: Commanders land Oweh on 4-year, $100M deal
articles.summary: Former Chargers defensive end Odafe Oweh, who has 17.5 sacks since 2024, has agreed with the Commanders on a four-year, $100 million deal, his agents told ESPN.

articles.title: Colts re-sign WR Pierce, trade Pittman to Steelers
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts are re-signing wide receiver Alec Pierce but are trading his running mate Michael Pittman Jr. out of town.

articles.title: Source: Saints spend $113M on Etienne, Edwards
articles.summary: The Saints have reached a four-year, $52M deal with ex-Jaguars RB Travis Etienne Jr. and a four-year, $61M deal with guard David Edwards, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Raiders give C Linderbaum record deal
articles.summary: Free agent center Tyler Linderbaum reached agreement Monday on a record deal with the Raiders, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Commanders bringing back QB Mariota
articles.summary: The Washington Commanders are re-signing backup quarterback Marcus Mariota on a one-year, $7 million deal, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Sources: Cowboys reach deal with S Thompson
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys have made another addition to their defense, agreeing to a three-year, $33 million contract with safety Jalen Thompson, sources told ESPN's Todd Archer.

articles.title: Sources: QB Willis, Fins reach 3-year, $67.5M deal
articles.summary: Free agent QB Malik Willis, after reviving his career with the Packers, has agreed to a three-year, $67.5 million deal with the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Seahawks to re-sign cornerback Jobe
articles.summary: The Seattle Seahawks are re-signing cornerback Josh Jobe to a three-year, $24 million contract, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Bengals signing Seahawks LB Mafe, Chiefs S Cook
articles.summary: The Cincinnati Bengals are bolstering their defense with former Seahawks LB Boye Mafe and former Chiefs safety Bryan Cooks.

articles.title: Browns bolster OL, reach deal with G Johnson
articles.summary: Free agent guard Zion Johnson and the Cleveland Browns reached agreement Monday on a three-year, $49.5 million deal that includes $32.4 million guaranteed, agents Alan Herman and Jared Fox told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Panthers land Phillips on 4-year deal, sources say
articles.summary: Linebacker Jaelan Phillips is signing with the Panthers, according to Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Agent: Steelers to add CB Dean on $36.75M deal
articles.summary: The Steelers have agreed to a three-year, $36.75 million deal with former Buccaneers cornerback Jamel Dean, agent Erik Burkhardt of Roc Nation Sports told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Bucs adding RB Gainwell, LB Anzalone
articles.summary: The Buccaneers have reached two-year deals with ex-Steelers running back Kenneth Gainwell and former Lions linebacker Alex Anzalone, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Cardinals land Allgeier on $12.25M deal
articles.summary: The Arizona Cardinals are signing RB Tyler Allgeier to a two-year, $12.5 million deal, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler
